newsitem.title: USA: Alco Standard corrects FY97 EPS outlook.
newsitem.headline: Alco Standard corrects FY97 EPS outlook.

text.p: Alco Standard Corp said it was forecasting fiscal 1997 earnings per share growth of 35-40 percent, not 30-35 percent as discussed by company chairman John Stuart in an interview with Reuters.

Company spokesman Mike Kilpatric said Alco Standard, which is to change its name to IKON Office Solutions Inc this month, continued to forecast 30-35 percent operating income growth for 1997, as Stuart said earlier.
It also expected 30-35 percent growth in earnings per share and operating income in the following years through 2000, he said.
